request.description: Returns { uploadUrl, fileUrl }. PUT the raw file bytes directly to uploadUrl (with a matching Content-Type header, no auth) within 5 minutes — the presigned URL expires after that. fileUrl is the permanent CloudFront URL to store/display once the upload completes. Any authenticated user or admin token works — this endpoint isn't role-gated.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Wireless Bluetooth Headphones",
  "subTitle": "Noise Cancelling Over-Ear",
  "description": "High-quality wireless headphones with deep bass.",
  "sellingPrice": 4999,
  "stock": 120,
  "categoryId": 1,
  "brandId": 1,
  "totalPoints": 100,
  "showTotalPoints": true,
  "showPointsSharing": true,
  "bulkAvailable": true,
  "consumerMinimumQuantity": 1,
  "consumerMaximumQuantity": 9,
  "resellerMinimumQuantity": 1,
  "resellerMaximumQuantity": 100
}

request.description: totalPoints is the points pool (per unit) this product carries, split across buyer/upline/pool via each active PointDistribution rule's pointsPercentage. showTotalPoints/showPointsSharing control whether the buyer-facing product detail exposes totalPoints and the per-receiver points breakdown, respectively. bulkAvailable gates whether the product shows up in the reseller listing (GET /products?type=reseller) and its bulk-purchase page. consumerMinimumQuantity/consumerMaximumQuantity and resellerMinimumQuantity/resellerMaximumQuantity bound how many units a buyer can hold in their cart for this product, per cart_type — enforced in CartService.addToCart. Admin is the sole product creator/owner (no merchant_id column exists anymore).

Unique per (productId, packageQuantity) — creating a duplicate package for the same product returns a 409. showTotalPoints/showPointsSharing default to true (unlike the product-level flags, which default to false) — set to false to hide this package's totalPoints/points breakdown on the reseller product view.
Hard delete — cascades to its replies and likes.

request.description: Create these in the order you want as your workflow (e.g. Pending -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered). The first row created (id 1) is used as the default status for every new redemption.
Points were already debited at redemption time — this only updates fulfilment status/tracking/remarks, never re-touches the buyer's points balance.

request.description: pointsPercentage (0-100) is the share of the purchased product's total_points this receiver gets — this is what actually drives crediting now. The legacy flat `points` field is no longer used by the distribution calculation and can be omitted. Active rules for the same eventType are expected to sum to <=100%.
